summary: MSC Income Fund, Inc. filed an 8-K on August 6, 2026, announcing regular monthly dividends of $0.11 per share for October, November, and December 2026, totaling $0.33 per share for Q4 2026, plus a supplemental cash dividend of $0.03 per share payable in December 2026 from undistributed taxable income as of June 30, 2026. This is a routine dividend declaration by a business development company, not a special situation. No M&A, strategic review, or other special event is involved. Watch for no further action; this is ordinary capital distribution activity.
